config.instant-actions.title: Instant Actions
config.instant-actions.disabled_warning:
Instant Actions is currently disabled.
Run /instant-actions enable true in chat to turn it back on.
config.instant-actions.double_tilling.to: Tilling a block also tills any adjacent blocks.
config.instant-actions.double_seeding.to: Planting a crop also plants the same crop on any adjacent empty plantable blocks.
Bonemealing a crop also applies bone meal to adjacent crops of the same type.
config.instant-actions.instant_crop_matu: Grow a crop to full maturity, consuming however many bone meal are required.
config.instant-actions.chain_harvest.too: Breaking a fully-grown crop harvests all connected crops of the same type, within a 3-block radius.
config.instant-actions.instant_compostin: Instantly fill a composter, consuming as many of the item as needed.
config.instant-actions.instant_taming.to: Guarantee taming on the first try.
config.instant-actions.instant_animal_ma: Feeding a baby animal instantly matures it to an adult.
config.instant-actions.restore_hunger_in: Consuming food uses as many of the same item as needed to fully restore hunger.
